title: READABLE SHARED STATUS LABELS
why: The active reload critic found the status title and damage detail too small at 1080p. Keep every status consistent in the existing left column.
now: Status names and values are larger in matching bordered panels; the active reload chain shows as a status with its count.

edits.replacement: nf=FS(TYPE.head); vf=FS(TYPE.label);   // v28.xx (cw-cx-statusread): shared status type grows from about 16/13 to 20/16 px at 1080p.
ctx.fillStyle='rgba(22,25,27,.90)'; statusPill(cx-ph/2,cy,tx+tw+LH(10),ph);   // v28.xx (cw-cx-statusread): style-guide panel fill for every status.
lw=Math.max(2,S*0.085); rr=r*0.8; u=S*0.24; hx=r*1.04; ph=S*1.12;   // v28.xx (cw-cx-statusread): the two larger text lines fit inside the shared panel.

edits.anchor:
ctx.font=nf; ctx.fillStyle=E.col;     ctx.fillText(E.nm,tx,cy-LH(2));
      ctx.font=vf; ctx.fillStyle='#cdd6dd'; ctx.fillText(E.v||'',tx,cy+LH(9));
wC=(S+LH(110))*hr;                         // one column, icon and words, on screen
edits.replacement: wC=(S+LH(130))*hr;   // v28.xx (cw-cx-statusread): collision clearance includes the larger shared status labels.
x=Math.floor(s/rows)*(S+LH(130)); y=(s%rows)*(S+g); s++;   // v28.xx (cw-cx-statusread): the same width when a second column is needed.
